hero.headline: Vendor Billing Software
hero.subhead: Automate your payable processes, ensure compliance, and eliminate overbilling with industrial-grade precision across every subcontractor pay application.
checklist: Cross-check pay apps against BOQ and SOV
Hold payments on missing lien waivers

features.title: Automated Pay App Verification
features.body: Cross-reference subcontractor pay applications against the Schedule of Values, approved change orders, and past payments to prevent overbilling. Arithmetic and logical checks run automatically.

features.title: Lien Waiver and Compliance Tracking
features.body: Automatically hold payments until all required documentation, including lien waivers and insurance certificates, is securely collected and verified.

faqs.q: How does the automated verification work?
faqs.a: Incoming pay applications are cross-referenced against the approved Schedule of Values, previously billed amounts, and active change orders, with discrepancies highlighted instantly.

faqs.q: Can it integrate with our existing ERP?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow exports vendor bills to Tally Prime and pushes to Zoho Books, keeping your financial stack in sync.

faqs.q: What happens if a lien waiver is missing?
faqs.a: Payments are flagged and held until all required documentation is collected and verified by the compliance team.
